findings.title: PROD deployment is reachable without any detected test
findings.whyItMatters: Nothing on the path to this deployment runs tests, so a change can be deployed without automated validation.
findings.explanation: No test step was found before `Production` in `shop-release`. It runs after stage `BuildProd` (previous stage, implicit order), in pipeline `shop-release` (No push trigger (`trigger: none`)).
findings.suggestedAction: Confirm which validation should run before this deployment.

findings.title: Changes to shared library Shop.Common do not start `pr-validation`
findings.whyItMatters: Api uses Shop.Common, but the path filters of the pipeline that validates Api exclude the library: a library change can reach Api without that validation.
findings.explanation: Shop.Common (`src/Shop.Common`) is referenced by Api (`src/Shop.Api`). `pr-validation`: path filter on pull requests does not include it (includes src/Shop.Api, tests).

findings.title: Changes to shared library Shop.Common do not start `worker-build`
findings.whyItMatters: Worker uses Shop.Common, but the path filters of the pipeline that validates Worker exclude the library: a library change can reach Worker without that validation.
findings.explanation: Shop.Common (`src/Shop.Common`) is referenced by Worker (`src/Shop.Worker`). `worker-build`: path filter on pushes does not include it (includes src/Shop.Worker).

findings.title: Integration tests do not gate the QA deployment
findings.whyItMatters: Integration tests run in this pipeline, but the QA deployment does not depend on them: it can proceed while they fail or before they run.
findings.explanation: `dotnet test` in `IntegrationTests`; `DeployQA` runs after stage `DeployDev`, `InfraQA`, in pipeline `shop-build` (Pushes to `main` (only changes under `src`, `infra`)).
findings.suggestedAction: Confirm whether the QA deployment should depend on the integration tests.

findings.title: No post-deployment validation detected after the PROD deployment in `shop-release`
findings.whyItMatters: Without a smoke test, health check or test after deploying, a broken deployment is only noticed by people or monitoring.
findings.explanation: No test or health check runs after `Production` in `shop-release` (later steps of the job, its strategy's post phases, or stages that depend on it).
findings.suggestedAction: Add or confirm a post-deployment check (smoke test, health check) for this environment.

findings.title: No post-deployment validation detected after the QA deployment in `shop-build`
findings.whyItMatters: Without a smoke test, health check or test after deploying, a broken deployment is only noticed by people or monitoring.
findings.explanation: No test or health check runs after `DeployQA` in `shop-build` (later steps of the job, its strategy's post phases, or stages that depend on it).
findings.suggestedAction: Add or confirm a post-deployment check (smoke test, health check) for this environment.

findings.title: No detectable link from QA to Production
findings.whyItMatters: Production is deployed by a different pipeline with no pipeline trigger or artifact relationship to the QA deployment; promotion order is decided outside the definitions.
findings.explanation: QA: `shop-build`; Production: `shop-release`, which runs after stage `BuildProd` (previous stage, implicit order), in pipeline `shop-release` (No push trigger (`trigger: none`)). `shop-release` declares `shop-build` as pipeline resource `shopBuild` without a trigger, and does not download its artifacts.
findings.suggestedAction: Confirm how a change is promoted from QA to Production (pipeline trigger, artifact resource, manual procedure).

findings.title: Production and QA appear to use different builds
findings.whyItMatters: The artifact tested in QA may not be the same artifact deployed to Production.
findings.explanation: QA deploys output of `shop-build` stage `Build`; Production deploys output of `shop-release` stage `BuildProd`.
findings.suggestedAction: Confirm Production should promote the QA-tested artifact rather than rebuild.

findings.title: A change to contract Shop API may not start validation of consumer Worker
findings.whyItMatters: The consumer's pipeline does not start when the contract it uses changes, so an incompatible contract change may not be built or tested against the consumer.
findings.explanation: `shop/src/Shop.Api/openapi.json` is consumed by Worker (OpenApiReference in project file — a generated client consumes this contract; references `../Shop.Api/openapi.json`). `worker-build`: path filter on pushes does not include it (includes src/Shop.Worker).

evidence.note: OpenApiReference in project file — a generated client consumes this contract

findings.suggestedAction: Review whether `worker-build` should start on changes to `src/Shop.Api/openapi.json`.

findings.title: Security scans do not appear to gate normal delivery
findings.whyItMatters: The scans run, but not on the dependency path of any deployment (scheduled, conditional, soft or in a separate pipeline).
findings.explanation: `Weekly dependency scan` in `shop-build`: Pushes to `main` (only changes under `src`, `infra`) — only when `eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'Schedule')` (continueOnError).
findings.suggestedAction: Confirm whether a scan result should be able to stop a deployment.

findings.title: Template `compliance/checks.yml@platform` is not analyzed
findings.whyItMatters: What the template runs (tests, deployments) is not visible; findings that depend on it are reported as not assessable instead.
findings.explanation: External template from repository resource 'platform' — not analyzed (add a Source Analysis snapshot of that repository).
findings.suggestedAction: Analyze the template's repository in Source Analysis, or confirm what it contains.

findings.title: Unreferenced pipeline template `shop/pipelines/templates/unused.yml`
findings.whyItMatters: No pipeline in this snapshot includes it. It may be used by pipelines in other repositories.
findings.explanation: No template use in this snapshot resolves to this file.
findings.suggestedAction: Confirm whether the template is still used.

findings.title: No rollback mechanism detected for the PROD deployment
findings.whyItMatters: A defined rollback (slot swap, on-failure steps, rollout undo) makes recovery from a bad release faster. It may exist outside the pipeline.
findings.explanation: No rollback mechanism detected in pipeline source (this does not mean rollback is impossible).
findings.suggestedAction: Confirm how a failed production release is rolled back.
